items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: That's Harold Bunch. He was a very good musician too. I don't know if he still plays.

ctx.x: I've heard of him too, yeah. He was a dancer. That's a good picture of him. See, Leo played violin also.
He had his violin there. That's Harold Bunch. He was a very good musician too. I don't know if he still plays. He lives in California. I think he does some.
I don't think he's very active, but I think he still plays some. He was very good.
